bullets.title: Support broke
bullets.text: Gold slipped below 4,050 on Friday morning to about 4,037-4,045 (Trading Economics, LiteFinance), under the 4,075 and 4,057 supports; exact quote time UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Still up weekly
bullets.text: Even after the drop, gold is on track for a weekly gain of more than 4%, after Thursday's high near 4,147.

bullets.title: Dollar firming
bullets.text: The dollar index is up slightly at about 101.7-101.8, and the US 10-year yield is near 4.82-4.84%, a two-month low.

bullets.title: Hike odds mixed
bullets.text: Reports put December Fed hike odds anywhere from about 68% to 80% (CME FedWatch), so the exact figure is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Middle East risk
bullets.text: Tanker and vessel attacks near the Strait of Hormuz lifted oil, which can support gold if fear spreads.

bullets.title: Jobs report today
bullets.text: The October jobs report is at 15:30 SAST, expected 65k with unemployment at 4.2%; a strong beat can push gold toward 4,000.
